macroTarget.note: Trainer target for Jmo: fat loss, lean muscle gain, and metabolism support. Daily structure is 3 whole-food meals plus 1 high-protein snack.

dailyHabits: Hit 155-160g protein before worrying about perfection elsewhere.
Build meals from lean protein, approved carbohydrates, vegetables, and controlled healthy fats.
Use the 30g protein list for fast swaps when travel, kids, or work blow up the plan.
Log meals, workout, water, and weight once per day.

trackerDefaults.workoutGoal: Complete planned lift/cardio or active recovery

recipeLibrary.name: Greek Yogurt with Berries and Almonds
instructions: Combine Greek yogurt and berries in a bowl.
Top with chopped almonds.

recipeLibrary.name: Spinach and Feta Omelet
instructions: Cook spinach in olive oil until wilted.
Add beaten eggs, cook until set, add feta, and fold.

recipeLibrary.name: Grilled Chicken Salad
instructions: Grill chicken until cooked through.
Build salad with vegetables, top with chicken, and drizzle vinaigrette.

recipeLibrary.name: Baked Salmon with Asparagus
instructions: Bake salmon and asparagus at 400F for 12-15 minutes.
Finish with lemon.

recipeLibrary.name: Lemon Garlic Shrimp with Broccoli
instructions: Cook garlic and shrimp until pink.
Saute broccoli until tender.
Combine and finish with lemon.

recipeLibrary.name: Turkey Meatballs with Cauliflower Rice
instructions: Bake turkey meatballs at 375F for 20-25 minutes.
Pulse cauliflower into rice and saute until tender.

recipeLibrary.name: Slow Cooker Chicken and Quinoa Casserole
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Place all ingredients in crockpot.
Cook on low for 6-8 hours.

recipeLibrary.name: Crockpot Turkey and Vegetable Chili
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Brown turkey.
Combine all ingredients in crockpot and cook on low for 6-8 hours.

recipeLibrary.name: Slow Cooker Beef and Broccoli
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Place beef and broccoli in crockpot.
Mix sauce separately, pour over, and cook on low for 5-7 hours.

recipeLibrary.name: Crockpot Lemon Garlic Chicken
recipeLibrary.source: Coach Jake's Lazy Winter Crockpot Recipes
instructions: Place chicken in crockpot.
Pour lemon garlic mixture over chicken and cook on low for 4-6 hours.

meals.name: HT BOGO Chicken Tenderloin Quinoa Primavera
meals.protein: Harris Teeter Chicken Breast or Chicken Tenderloins
meals.macroFit: Chicken tenderloins cook fast and keep the plate lean; quinoa and vegetables add fiber without a heavy sauce.
instructions: Cook quinoa while prepping the chicken and vegetables.
Season chicken with garlic, Italian seasoning, pepper, lemon zest, and a light drizzle of olive oil.
Sear chicken 4 to 5 minutes per side until cooked through; rest and slice.
Sauté broccoli, zucchini, and carrots until crisp-tender, then wilt in spinach.
Toss quinoa, vegetables, chicken, and lemon juice; add parsley or basil if available.

meals.name: HT Argentine Shrimp Brown Rice Skillet
meals.protein: Wild Caught Peeled & Deveined Argentine Shrimp
meals.macroFit: Shrimp is lean and quick; brown rice and a large vegetable base make it filling without much added fat.
instructions: Thaw shrimp if needed and pat dry.
Warm brown rice pouches while chopping vegetables.
Sauté zucchini and peppers with garlic, smoked paprika, and pepper until crisp-tender.
Add shrimp and cook 2 to 3 minutes per side until opaque; fold in spinach and tomatoes.
Serve over brown rice with lime and cilantro or parsley.

meals.name: HT Pork Loin Sweet Potato Green Bean Plates
meals.macroFit: Slice the pork loin into quick 5 oz cutlets and keep the plate centered on green vegetables and sweet potatoes.
instructions: Microwave sweet potatoes until tender, turning once halfway through.
Slice pork loin into thin cutlets and season with garlic, pepper, paprika, and a thin swipe of Dijon.
Sear pork 3 to 4 minutes per side until cooked through; rest and slice.
Sauté green beans and kale until crisp-tender.
Serve pork with sweet potatoes, greens, sliced apples, and a quick vinegar-Dijon slaw.

meals.name: HT 93% Lean Ground Chuck Taco Farro Bowls
meals.macroFit: The 93% lean beef keeps fat controlled; farro, beans, and vegetables make the bowl more balanced than tortillas alone.
instructions: Cook farro according to package directions.
Brown ground chuck with chili powder, cumin, garlic, smoked paprika, and pepper; drain if needed.
Sauté peppers and onions until tender-crisp.
Warm rinsed black beans and chop romaine and tomatoes.
Build bowls with farro, beans, vegetables, beef, lime, and salsa.

meals.name: ALDI Sockeye Salmon Quinoa Veggie Plates
meals.protein: Fremont Fish Market Wild Alaska Sockeye Salmon
meals.macroFit: A 5 oz salmon portion brings healthy fats; the quinoa blend and potatoes keep the carb side whole-food and filling.
instructions: Microwave or air-fry halved baby potatoes until tender and browned.
Cook salmon according to package directions, pulling it when just opaque.
Warm quinoa veggie blend in a skillet.
Fold spinach and tomatoes into the hot quinoa blend to soften.
Plate quinoa vegetables, potatoes, and salmon with lemon.

meals.name: ALDI Lemon Pepper Chicken Wing Rice Bowls
meals.macroFit: Use baked or air-fried wings without sugary sauce and round out the bowl with brown rice, edamame, and crunchy vegetables.
instructions: Air-fry or convection-bake wings with lemon pepper, garlic, and paprika until crisp and cooked through.
Warm brown rice and edamame.
Steam or sauté broccoli until crisp-tender.
Toss cabbage slaw and cucumbers with lemon juice and a small drizzle of olive oil.
Build bowls with rice, edamame, broccoli, slaw, and portioned wings.
